content: Atharv Pandey confirmed receipt of a form from agent Anjali Desai and inquired about the subsequent steps. Anjali explained that she would review the signed form to update policy details, a process expected to take 2-3 working days. Atharv requested confirmation on whether the policy status would remain active or become pending after the update.

action_items: Customer to sign and return the form
Agent to review form and update policy details
Agent to send email notification upon completion
Agent to confirm if policy remains active or becomes pending
